tasks.label: Build Runner (Verilator)
tasks.command: mkdir -p out && verilator --cc --trace --exe --build -j 0 -Mdir out/obj_dir -o r128_runner ${workspaceFolder}/asm/runner.cpp $(find rtl -name '*.sv' | sort) --top-module main && cp -f out/obj_dir/r128_runner out/r128_runner

tasks.label: Run Program (current .bin / .asm)
tasks.command: BIN="${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bin"; if [ ! -f "$BIN" ]; then echo "BIN not found: $BIN"; echo "Сначала запустите задачу Assemble"; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -x out/r128_runner ] && [ ! -x out/obj_dir/r128_runner ]; then echo "Runner не собран. Запустите Build Runner"; exit 1; fi; RUNNER=out/r128_runner; [ -x "$RUNNER" ] || RUNNER=out/obj_dir/r128_runner; "$RUNNER" "$BIN" --input ${input:r128Input} --latency ${input:memLatency} --max-cycles ${input:maxCycles}

tasks.label: Assemble & Run (current .asm)
tasks.command: python3 asm/asm.py "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bin" --listing "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.lst" && BIN="${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bin" && RUNNER=out/r128_runner && [ -x "$RUNNER" ] || RUNNER=out/obj_dir/r128_runner && if [ ! -x "$RUNNER" ]; then echo "Runner не собран. Сначала Build Runner (Verilator)"; exit 1; fi && "$RUNNER" "$BIN" --input ${input:r128Input} --latency ${input:memLatency} --max-cycles ${input:maxCycles}

tasks.label: Open Waveform (current program)
tasks.command: VCD="${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.vcd"; if [ ! -f "$VCD" ]; then echo "VCD не найден: $VCD"; echo "Сначала запустите программу (Run Program / Assemble & Run)"; exit 1; fi; if command -v surfer >/dev/null 2>&1; then surfer "$VCD"; elif command -v gtkwave >/dev/null 2>&1; then gtkwave "$VCD"; else echo "Не найден surfer или gtkwave"; open "$VCD" 2>/dev/null || xdg-open "$VCD" 2>/dev/null || echo "Откройте $VCD вручную"; fi

tasks.label: Build (Verilator full testbench)
tasks.command: mkdir -p out && verilator --cc --trace --exe --build -j 0 -Mdir out/obj_dir -o Vmain tb/test__.cpp $(find rtl -name '*.sv' | sort) --top-module main

tasks.label: Open Waveform (testbench VCD)
tasks.command: if command -v surfer >/dev/null 2>&1; then surfer out/r128.vcd; elif command -v gtkwave >/dev/null 2>&1; then gtkwave out/r128.vcd; else echo "Не найден surfer/gtkwave"; fi

tasks.label: Synthesis (Yosys)
tasks.command: mkdir -p out && files=$(find rtl -type f -name '*.sv' | sort | tr '\n' ' ') && yosys -m slang -p "read_slang --top main $files; synth -top main; write_json out/main.json"

tasks.label: Graphviz (R128: Simple schematic)
tasks.command: mkdir -p out/graphviz && files=$(find rtl -type f -name '*.sv' | sort | tr '\n' ' ') && yosys -m slang -p "read_slang --top main $files; prep -top main; show -format dot -prefix out/graphviz/r128 main" && dot -Tsvg -Gsplines=line -Grankdir=LR -Goverlap=false out/graphviz/r128.dot -o out/graphviz/r128.svg
